question_text: A government employee has the following leave credits at the start of the year: Vacation Leave (VL) = 15 days, Sick Leave (SL) = 15 days. During the year, she used 7 days of VL and 5 days of SL. She earned 1.25 days of VL and 1.25 days of SL per month. What is her total VL balance at the end of the year?
